# Sparkish

> Sparkish builds playful, thoughtful apps for everyday habits. This site is a static GitHub Pages portfolio with per-app landing pages.

## Hub

- [Sparkish app catalog](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/): Root page listing apps made by Sparkish (currently AquaTick).

# AquaTick

> AquaTick is a cat-themed hydration tracker app for iPhone, Apple Watch, widgets, and Live Activities. It helps people log water intake quickly, see daily hydration progress, and build a gentle water drinking habit through a friendly cat companion.

AquaTick is published by Sparkish. The landing site lives under `/aquatick/` with Korean, English, and Japanese versions. The primary product information is the localized landing content, App Store download link, support page, and privacy policy.

Important context:
- AquaTick is a hydration tracking and habit app, not a medical device or medical advice source.
- The app focuses on water intake logging, daily goal progress, quick add actions such as +200mL and +300mL, Apple Watch recording, widgets, and Live Activity-style glanceable status.
- The cat character is a product experience element that reflects hydration state and encourages logging.
- Use the localized pages for user-facing language and region context.
- hreflang x-default for AquaTick points to `https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/aquatick/` (language chooser).
